title: Blueberry, Oat and Cinnamon Smoothie
excerpt: Enjoy a creamy smoothie with high-mountain blueberries, oats and a hint of cinnamon. A delicious, quick option that is perfect for starting the day.
imageAlt: Glass cup with a creamy violet smoothie garnished with fresh blueberries and a touch of ground cinnamon on a wooden table.

ingredients.text: 1 cup almond milk or whole milk

steps: Put the rolled oats in the blender and process them for a few seconds until you get a fine powder.
Add the Fresh Pick blueberries, carefully grown in the cold of Guasca.
Pour in the almond milk or the milk of your choice along with the ground cinnamon.
Add the honey if you want an extra touch of sweetness. We use half the usual sweetener because Fresh Pick blueberries have more natural sugar.
Blend on high speed for two minutes until the mixture is completely smooth and creamy.
Serve immediately in cold glasses and garnish with a few whole blueberries on top.
tips: If you prefer a colder, thicker texture, you can freeze the blueberries beforehand.
Store your blueberries in the fridge unwashed and eat them soon to enjoy their natural bloom and flavor to the fullest.
This recipe uses half the usual sweetener: Fresh Pick blueberries have more natural sugar, so we cut it back. Taste it and, if you prefer it sweeter, add a little more.
